write_arguments: All dry-run arguments, rebuilt/verified again at time of write
--output <new absolute .json path under that private root; parent must exist and be mode0700>
gates: Every original source pin still matches, including original r17 entry
Systemd current MainPID, active/running state, selected ExecStart and cgroup match actual proc argv/executable
Fresh boot and two matching process start_ticks/cmdline hashes; old same-boot PID reuse fails
Pinned native launch metadata selects the pinned camera UI/candidate config
Actual generated camera config must match the original runtime config byte SHA exactly before a boot/PID path relocation
Actual camera identity config selects the exact unchanged DPU SFace model ID/SHA/dimension/TTL/database path
Hash actual DPU model and model manifest files without loading runner; recheck all sources/process/model proofs before candidate creation
No source pin removal: add only the new identical runtime config path/digest
Explicit reviewed observation token, private POSIX output, exclusive create and fsync; never overwrite original or existing files
public_report: Pin/hash/count/owner/ready status only. On runtime byte mismatch, report existing schema field names and mask arbitrary added keys; no source values or gallery data.
limits: Ready means current metadata pins were verified at that snapshot, not that a face identity or database row was read. FaceGalleryReadback must still reverify the candidate on each use.

Pinned native_entry replaces its seed from the checkpoint, so a new runtime may differ in native_execution.seed.sha256. This generator intentionally returns ready=false; it does not accept semantic-only equivalence or relax thresholds.
No actual board/proc/systemd read, private database access, model runner, network/Windows face payload, deploy, service reload, boot/FDT/firmware or mechanical operation was executed by this subtask.
